text: Water Polo | The Georgian national team defeated Turkey and took a big step towards the World Cup #1TVSPORT

The Georgian national water polo team played the Round of 16 match of the World Cup qualification stage against Turkey and won 19:12. This was a worthy revenge for the defeat against the same team in the group stage.

With this victory, the Georgians advanced to the quarterfinals, where their opponent will be determined later (the winner between Canada and Ukraine). To qualify for the World Cup, the Georgian national team needs to win two more matches – the quarterfinal and the semifinal. The two finalists will secure a spot in the World Cup Super Final.
The 2026 Water Polo World Cup will be held in Australia from July 22 to 26.
